title: unified-rollouts: observability & enhanced rollback metrics
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: improve observability around unified rollouts to make automated rollback decisions transparent and debuggable. This PR exposes additional rollout metrics, adds metric-matching logic to the controller, and wires those metrics into the Console so teams can understand why a canary/AB/shadow rollback was triggered. Key goals: 1) Surface the signal inputs (errors, latency P95/P99, model divergence stats) used by autorollback workflows; 2) Provide metric matching and histogram bucketing to reduce false positives; 3) Make rollouts' decision traces queryable from Console and logs for on-call debugging. Changes are backward-compatible with existing rollout config schema; default behavior preserved unless users opt into the enhanced metric set. Checklist: - [x] Controller metric selector + matcher implementation - [x] Prometheus instrumentation + rollout metrics export - [x] Console UI: rollout metric panel + decision trace viewer - [x] Unit and integration tests for matcher logic - [x] Documentation updates (docs/rollouts.md) - [x] Rollout experiments run in staging (ENG-1458) - [x] Load tested for 1k RPS canary traffic (no perf regression) Notes: This touches the controller core path; I ran integration tests against a staging cluster and validated that existing rollouts without the new metrics behave identically. The PR references Linear tickets for follow-ups (ENG-1472 for configurable metric thresholds in rollout templates).

release_notes: Enhancement: Expose rollout decision inputs (errors, latency P95/P99, divergence) as Prometheus metrics.
Enhancement: Add metric-matching engine to reduce false positive autorollbacks for overlapping rules.
UI: Console panel to view rollout metrics and decision traces for easier on-call debugging.
Migration: No schema-breaking changes. Users must opt into enhanced metrics; default rollout templates unchanged.
